full_prompt_en:
A whimsical character illustration presents a shaggy, horned wanderer crouched on bare ground beside a small white bird. The wanderer carries an enormous patched pack crowded with tools and dangling objects, and holds a short walking stick in one hand. Large ears, round goggles, rough hair, and a long beard give the figure an eccentric silhouette. The bird turns its narrow head toward him, making their quiet exchange the center of the image. Nearly all the surrounding space is plain warm parchment, so every small object on the pack can be read without competing scenery.

The drawing combines fine exploratory linework with muted watercolor-like washes. Sepia, umber, dusty olive, and slate grey build the larger body; pale cream keeps the bird bright. Edges are uneven and lightly sketched, especially in hair, fabric, feathers, and worn leather, while darker precise accents organize the face and gear. The light is soft and neutral, creating gentle ground shadows rather than dramatic highlights. Detail gathers densely around the central pair and falls away into broad negative space. The hand-designed animation concept quality combines odd proportions, practical wear and affectionate observation. Dry, slightly rough material texture accompanies warm paper showing through the washes. There is no legible lettering in this selected image.
full_prompt_zh:
一幅奇想角色插画描绘一名毛发蓬乱、长角的旅者蹲在空地上，身旁站着一只白色小鸟。旅者背着巨大的补丁行囊，里面塞满工具并挂着各种小物，一只手握短杖。大耳朵、圆护目镜、粗乱头发和长胡子构成古怪的剪影。小鸟转过细长的头望向他，使两者安静的交流成为画面中心。四周几乎全是素净的暖羊皮纸色，所以行囊上的每件小物都清晰可读，不受背景景物争夺注意。

画法结合细密的探索性线稿与柔和的水彩式薄涂。棕褐、赭棕、灰橄榄绿和石板灰组成较大的身体形体；浅乳白让鸟保持明亮。边缘不齐且带轻微草图感，尤其是毛发、织物、羽毛和磨旧皮革；较深的准确重音则整理面部与装备。光柔和而中性，只形成轻微的地面阴影，没有戏剧性高光。细节密集在中央一对角色周围，向大片留白逐渐散去。保留手绘动画概念稿的品质：古怪比例、实用磨损和带感情的观察可信地并存。材质略干、稍粗糙，暖纸色从薄涂中透出来。所选画面没有可辨认文字。
style_prompt_en: Fine exploratory lines and muted watercolor-like washes gather into a compact central cluster on warm parchment space. Sepia, umber, dusty olive, slate grey, and pale cream keep the palette earthy and restrained. Uneven, lightly sketched contours are especially active around frayed and fibrous textures, while a few dark, precise accents clarify the densest details. Soft neutral light gives forms gentle volume and a slight grounding shadow. Intricate small marks concentrate in one area, then dissolve quickly into broad untouched space. Proportions are playful but materially plausible; worn surfaces and dry brush grain keep the design tactile. The finish feels like a thoughtful hand-drawn animation concept, observational and affectionate without glossy polish.
style_prompt_zh: 细密而探索性的线条与柔和的水彩式薄涂，在暖羊皮纸色空间里聚成紧凑的中央团块。棕褐、赭棕、灰橄榄绿、石板灰和浅乳白使色谱质朴而收敛。不均匀、略带草图感的轮廓在磨散和纤维状纹理周围尤为活跃，少数精准深色重音澄清最密集的细节。柔和中性的光赋予形体轻微体积和贴地阴影。复杂的小痕迹集中于一区，随后迅速消散到大片未触碰的空间。比例富于玩味，却在材料上可信；磨损表面和干笔颗粒让设计有触感。完成效果像一张用心绘制的动画概念稿，观察细致而亲切，没有光滑的精修。
theme_en: An old wanderer pauses with an odd little companion
theme_zh: 年老旅者与古怪小伙伴驻足
name: Cory Loftis
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
